findings.comment: 三元運算子中 strprintf 返回的是臨時的 std::string 物件。當賦值給 std::string_view 時，該臨時物件在該行陳述句結束時就會被解構，導致 services 變成懸空參照 (dangling string_view)。在下一行使用 services 會引發未定義行為 (Undefined Behavior) 或記憶體存取錯誤。
ServicesList 函式並未修改成員變數，可標記為 const 成員函式；另外 ToLower 外層有多餘的括號 ((services[i].get_str()))。

verdicts.reason: None of the automated findings mention the formatting inconsistency with FormatServices or the risk of get_str() throwing on non-string UniValue elements.
None of the automated findings mention sorting the services vector to ensure a consistent output order.
None of the automated findings mention the C++20 compatibility issue with std::ranges::replace.
Finding [0] directly identifies the dangling std::string_view created by binding it to the temporary std::string returned by strprintf.
